personality: Patient, polite and always hungry. He speaks kindly to the weak because they are the easiest to eat.
voice: All the better to see you with.

cards.title: The Old Sinner
cards.text: He was an old wolf of the wood, and the huntsman had been after him for years. He never fought what he could talk into his jaws. When a girl in a red cap came along the path one morning, he greeted her politely, walked beside her, and thought what a tender mouthful she would make.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884

cards.title: What Big Teeth
cards.text: He told her to look at the flowers and ran ahead to her grandmother's cottage. He spoke at the door in the girl's voice, swallowed the old woman, put on her nightcap and got into her bed. When the girl arrived she saw how large her grandmother's ears and eyes and hands had grown, and then her mouth. With one bound he swallowed her too.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884

cards.title: Stones
cards.text: Full and pleased with himself, he lay down in the bed and snored. He never woke while the huntsman cut him open and the two of them came out alive. They filled his belly with great stones instead. When he woke and tried to run, the stones were so heavy that he fell down dead. The huntsman went home with his skin.

source.author: Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm, 1812–57; English by Margaret Hunt, 1884
